documents.title: Security incident escalation policy
documents.text: Critical security incidents must be escalated to the incident commander within 15 minutes of detection. High-severity incidents must be escalated within 60 minutes.

documents.title: Invoice approval controls
documents.text: Invoices above USD 5,000 require approval from two finance reviewers. Lower-value invoices require one finance reviewer.

documents.title: Business continuity exercise
documents.text: The operations team runs a business continuity recovery exercise every quarter. Results are documented by the continuity lead.

documents.title: Employee onboarding checklist
documents.text: New employees complete privacy training during their first five business days. Managers confirm completion in the onboarding checklist.
